intro.titulo: How to use the CCO family,
intro.texto: A real Claude Code session, sped up and in Spanish, on Almacenes del Valle S.A.S., a test organisation with synthetic material.

cierre.aviso: Real Claude Code recording, sped up. Almacenes del Valle S.A.S. is a test organisation: the material is synthetic.

capitulos.texto: Two commands in Claude Code: the Criterio catalogue and the CCO family. It installs Augusto and Valeria, and Rostrum, the portal.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Augusto, the forecast. He processes the folder, recognises the Salesforce export and proposes the stages with the evidence each one requires.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Claude Code asks for permission to open the agent's files, which are outside the folder. It is authorised once.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: The terms: each agent asks for its own yes, with the name of whoever accepts. Here, a demo user.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Augusto's first result: 13 signals, among them 5 opportunities without a purchase order and 3 stalled for 71 days.

capitulos.titulo: Set it up in a conversation
capitulos.texto: Valeria, from sale to invoice. What was already answered is not asked again; she processes the discount matrix, with 3 levels, and the commission plan.

capitulos.titulo: The first result, in a table
capitulos.texto: What each agent found: 13 signals across 21 opportunities. Valeria matches what was won against what was signed and invoiced when the CLO and the CFO also run.

capitulos.titulo: The daily task, only with a yes
capitulos.texto: The family proposes a daily task that reviews only what is due. Here it was left to run by hand.

capitulos.titulo: Day to day, in your own words
capitulos.texto: Each agent is asked in natural language. Augusto lists the 5 opportunities in the Compromiso stage without a purchase order; the largest, OPP-1103, for 250,000,000.

capitulos.titulo: Day to day, in your own words
capitulos.texto: Valeria processes the 5 quotes against the matrix: 3 discounts of 22% approved by someone who can only go up to 20%.
